name: hbm_hc_root_xr4_diag-diag-COMMIT
purpose: DIAGNOSTIC stand-ins only, NEVER SUBMIT. Current QCHX12/SAFE1/TAILC1/PTFS1/SDIV17/TTPIPE1/SKP2 native graph passed max24/92023roots/role0; 2 tailchildren, 3mix SRAM and 2programme/table SRAM placed in larger parent. Actual source args and provenance in assembly receipt. Child stand-ins are explicit assumed timing; replace with actual k4 view for qualification. Compiled XR11 and per-quarter smoke latencies remain conditional pending die geometry reprice.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hbm_hc_root_static u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/static_hc/native/ot_hbm_hc_root_xr4_p40_native.v && echo lint-ok
